content.text: The profile shows one change: `plan_code` is missing and an unexpected `plan` column appears in the same position with the same four codes. I'll check that as a rename by validating a candidate that renames the column and keeps its rules.

input.contract_yaml:
# Member eligibility from a (synthetic) payer: one row per member, one file per day.
# Generated from the Synthea patients by packs/healthcare/generators/eligibility.py.
feed: healthcare.eligibility
version: 2
owner: vendor-ops@example.com
description: >
  Daily full eligibility file: every enrolled member with their plan and coverage dates.
  All data is synthetic.
classification: restricted
source:
  channels: [minio, sftp, api]
  filename_pattern: "elig_*.csv"
  # The business date in the name (elig_YYYYMMDD.csv). It must be a real date, not after
  # the day the file was received, and at most 7 days before it; otherwise the file is
  # quarantined (FILE.NAME_DATE). A name with no digits takes the date it was received.
  filename_date:
    regex: "^elig_([0-9]+)"
    format: "%Y%m%d"
    max_days_before_received: 7
    max_days_after_received: 0
format: { type: csv, delimiter: ",", encoding: utf-8, header: true }
expected_arrival: { cron: "0 6 * * *", grace: 2h }
on_row_violation: quarantine_row
max_bad_row_ratio: 0.05          # above this, the whole file is rejected
min_rows: 1
columns:
  - { name: member_id, type: string, required: true, unique: true, pattern: "^M[0-9]{9}$" }
  - { name: first_name, type: string, required: true, phi: true }
  - { name: last_name, type: string, required: true, phi: true }
  - { name: dob, type: date, required: true, min: "1900-01-01", max: today, phi: true }
  - { name: sex, type: string, required: true, allowed: [F, M, U] }
  - { name: plan, type: string, required: true, allowed: [HMO, PPO, EPO, HDHP] }
  - { name: coverage_start, type: date, required: true, min: "1990-01-01" }
  - { name: coverage_end, type: date, description: "Empty while coverage is open" }
  - name: patient_ref
    type: string
    description: The payer's link to the clinical record (here the Synthea patient id)
    phi: true

input.rationale:
Drift in elig_20261021.csv (job 1): the contract's plan_code column is missing and an unexpected column plan sits in the same position (6). The values match the contract exactly: the same four codes (EPO, HDHP, HMO, PPO), 24 of 24 rows non-empty, and the same AAA/AAAA shapes. I read this as a deliberate rename of plan_code to plan, not a dropped column or junk. The candidate renames the column and keeps its type, required flag and allowed list; all other columns are unchanged, and version goes from 1 to 2.
Loosening: validate_contract reports one item, plan_code dropped as a required column. That is the rename itself, since the old name no longer exists in the file. No other rule is loosened. The reviewer should confirm with the vendor that plan_code was renamed rather than replaced.
Observation, not changed: the profile labels coverage_end and coverage_start as phi, and the contract has them without phi. Per rule 2 I kept the existing rules for existing columns, so this is left for the reviewer.
Dry run: 24 accepted, 0 rejected, file not rejected.

content.text:
- **What changed in the file:** The `plan_code` column was renamed to `plan`. It has the same position and the same four codes (EPO, HDHP, HMO, PPO), and all 24 rows are filled.
- **What the contract changes:** I renamed `plan_code` to `plan` and kept its type, required flag and allowed list. I also bumped the version from 1 to 2. I submitted the candidate (`24d6d81a9f207662`) for review.
- **What it loosens and why:** The validator reports one loosening: `plan_code` is no longer a required column. That is only the rename, since the old name is gone from the file. A reviewer should confirm with the vendor that this was a rename. I also noticed that `coverage_start` and `coverage_end` are labelled PHI in the profile but not in the contract. I left them alone because the existing columns keep their rules.
- **Dry run:** 24 accepted, 0 rejected, and the file was not rejected.
